name: fleet-eligibility-dispatch-readiness
objective: Close partner-fleet lifecycle and every Captain dispatch eligibility predicate, including accreditation, WLT financial eligibility, freshness, absence, service area and transactional capacity.
truthOwner: DSH owns dispatch candidate selection and partner-fleet relationship; WLT owns financial eligibility values consumed as an opaque projection.

tasks.currentProblem: Fleet linkage can become a dispatch authority without complete secret, revocation and cross-actor guarantees.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise one-time code issue/redeem, digest-only persistence, expiry, replay, revoke/disconnect, Captain/partner list and redacted operator readback; remove stale alternate linkage paths after caller census.
tasks.targetState: One auditable DSH fleet relationship governs Captain eligibility with no reusable secret or cross-tenant leakage.
tasks.action: Trace Product Truth to DB/API/UI callers, close missing lifecycle transitions, add actor/replay tests and remove duplicate linkage paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Dead alternate linkage paths are removed.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused fleet adapters while preserving canonical relationship/audit history.

tasks.objective: Prove every dispatch eligibility predicate and transactional capacity
tasks.currentProblem: Any omitted/stale predicate or non-transactional capacity check can assign an ineligible Captain.
tasks.requiredChange: Test accreditation, availability, financial eligibility/expiry, profile freshness, absence, service area and capacity independently and combined; recompute under row lock in assignment transaction; reject missing/unavailable projections rather than guessing.
tasks.targetState: Candidate selection and final assignment validation use the same fail-closed predicates and cannot oversubscribe capacity.
tasks.action: Trace candidate query and final transactional validator, align predicates, add boundary/concurrency tests and preserve WLT projection opacity.
mustNotChange: DSH must not calculate WLT balance/eligibility arithmetic.
No eligibility predicate is silently dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: WLT projection remains opaque and fail-closed.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused eligibility change without weakening existing fail-closed predicates.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused eligibility/capacity commit with PostgreSQL concurrency proof.
